crossRefs.note: He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.
But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:
who were born not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent…
Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and…
For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,
The testimony is this, that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.
We know that the Son of God has come, and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true, and we are in…
Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.
Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ, doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has…
Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting…
Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.
House of Jacob, come, and let’s walk in the light of Yahweh.
Many nations will go and say, “Come! Let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and…
Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
for we walk by faith, not by sight.
I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live…
I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,
Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a…
Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may…
Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and…
he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.
